cx2_truthful.basis: The recorded B-12 dispatch establishes an assigned task before entry. Alarm history and the work order corroborate maintenance; Marrow explains delayed documentation. The seal audit supports untouched boxes, and the radio log confirms completion reporting. Pell explains the door interval as tank emptying while remaining at the doorway. The records close the main gaps without establishing concealed involvement.

cx2_deceptive.basis: The recorded B-10 task was completed before Pell entered B-12 without an assigned task. The audit documents ACQ-117’s replacement seal and no custodian release; A3 acknowledges performing the resealing. These establish involvement beyond the humidity assignment, while Pell withholds the account of activity inside B-12 and any explanation of the held door.

cx3.basis: Marrow corroborates a B-wing humidity dispatch but cannot confirm B-12. Pell describes maintenance, while the access report establishes entry and a prolonged open door. The examined records do not resolve task authorization or explain the door handling. These gaps prevent a truthful finding, but no record establishes involvement that Pell’s answers conceal.
